summary.text: Sarah Anthony is a Democratic state senator from Michigan State Senate District 21 who has served since January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She chairs the Senate Appropriations Committee and previously represented District 68 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Sarah Anthony was born and lives in Lansing, Michigan, and graduated from Everett High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in political science and legal studies from Central Michigan University and a master's degree in public administration from Western Michigan University.
Her career experience includes working as deputy director of the Michigan College Access Network and as a state legislative assistant.
Anthony served in the Michigan House from 2019 to 2023, including on the House Appropriations Committee, and was minority vice chair of the Rules and Competitiveness Committee in 2021 and 2022.
In the Senate, she has chaired the Appropriations Committee since 2023.
